body: Windows ships and the tag-driven release works. PRs #297, #298, #299 and the lab-found export fix #300 are merged. Tag v1.0.0-rc.1 (main 122b386d) ran release 37882814178: the first attempt failed only because ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS did not match the keystore alias; after the owner reset it with --body field-notes, re-running the failed jobs published pre-release "Field Notes 1.0.0-rc.1" with the DMG, the Windows x64 setup exe, the APK and SHA256SUMS.txt. Verified locally: all three checksums match; the APK verifies (v2) with signer SHA-256 6cfac685...e71b, the new ~/field-notes-release.jks key, versionName 1.0.0-rc.1, versionCode 4, label Field Notes; the Mac app inside the DMG reads 1.0.0 (build 4) and is ad-hoc signed. Remaining owner-side checks, recorded as live risks: real-PC GPU rendering and Windows media and Meadow.
